## Goal
`tests/test_redaction.py` covers the regex backstops, separators, the DOB backstop, format args, the log file and tracebacks. Not covered: that every field `register_profile` registers is really redacted (`src/freemyid/logging_setup.py:64-86`), `stack_info` (136-137), the bad-format-args fallback (125-128), all nine DOB forms (45-51), the short and all-digit word-boundary rule (37-38, 94-95) and timestamps being kept (26-29).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. A fake profile with every PII field set (name with middle and suffix, two previous names, nicknames, two addresses with street/city/zip, DOB, phones, emails, relatives, `consent.attested_by`, mailbox address and username) is registered with `register_profile`; each value, and the "First Last" / "Last First" forms (72), logged through a logger carrying `RedactingFilter` (123-138) as plain text, upper case, `quote`/`quote_plus` encoded and joined by `+`, `_`, `-`, `.` or `%20` never appears in the formatted output.
2. A record with `stack_info=True` and a record with mismatched format args (`log.info("%s %s", one_value)`) are both redacted and never raise.
3. Each of the nine date forms of a registered DOB (45-51) is redacted; an ISO timestamp such as `2026-11-09T12:00:00` is kept.
4. A registered 5-digit ZIP is redacted when it stands alone but not inside a longer run of digits (an order number); a one-character value is ignored without error.
5. Every test restores the module's `_pii` set afterwards (the save/restore pattern at `tests/conftest.py:379-397`), so other tests are unaffected in any order.

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Offline: no network, no sockets (FastAPI `TestClient` is fine), no git, no installs, no new dependencies. Tests must pass on Windows CI too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp`, no `/`-joined path strings or other POSIX-only assumptions (WO-217 broke windows-latest that way). The module under test is outside Codex's code lane: a real product bug = `pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason=...)` plus a finding with file:line in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit it. Check `tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first and don't duplicate a guard. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them in your worktree.
